variants.headline: Still in view: government cannot pay its debts
variants.sub: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts.

The stewardship of {target} requires scrutiny against the inability to pay. This paper does not presume the origin of the debts or announce a response that the financial report has not established.
